look: Chalk geometry: a dark maths-explainer look (3Blue1Brown-style): clean vector dots, arrows and grids drawn in glowing strokes on a dark ground, shapes morphing smoothly, short serif captions. Same look as the Poisson, Metrics, IER, MeshAnything and Point2Mesh films of this series.

scenes.name: DHSP
scenes.desc: Title over our real DHSP mesh, coloured by its own texture.

scenes.name: A 3D self-prior first
scenes.desc: Like Point2Mesh, a mesh network pulls the hull in over four rounds, 2,000 to 16,000 triangles.

scenes.name: Why pictures
scenes.desc: Image networks are strong at filling in pictures, but a mesh is not a picture.

scenes.name: Flatten the skin
scenes.desc: Our real mesh is cut open and unfolded into a flat square: its UV map.

scenes.name: A picture of the shape
scenes.desc: Dots land in the square with their positions as colours; an image prior fills the gaps.

scenes.name: Painting the colours
scenes.desc: Dot colours land in the square; the real image prior paints the full texture, which wraps back on.

scenes.name: The whole pipeline
scenes.desc: Six steps from coloured dots to a textured mesh.

scenes.name: Part 1 in one line
scenes.desc: The hybrid idea in one sentence, and what Part 2 covers.
